notes.title: [Patch Note] New Update & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Block the Monster development team.

We would like to sincerely thank all of you for playing and supporting Block the Monster.

Even after the official release, we are continuously working on updates and improvements to deliver a better gameplay experience.




This update includes several hotfixes and improvements for a smoother and more stable environment.




\[Update Details]

Added and revised certain character dialogue texts

Fixed specific bugs occurring when deleting towers

Improved parts of the in-game UI

Overall performance optimization and stability enhancements




We will continue to resolve issues as quickly as possible and actively reflect your valuable feedback to further enhance the quality of the game.

Your continued support and feedback mean a lot to us.




Thank you,

Block the Monster Dev Team
